DECISIVE CROSS-CHECK, run before writing this: of Gibson's five 2026 keys in index.csv, key 8a163a02 (raw/y2026/2026_ugd_92078f_d8532285.pdf, pp1-3) holds a stated-totals cache of EXACTLY the cover I read here — contributions last 66,670.65 / this 21,550.00 / cum 88,220.65 and expenditures this 36,573.66. I did NOT touch vision/*.json, index.csv or any CSV. WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE RECORD: the rows below are the document in front of me, transcribed on its own terms, and they reconcile to the cent against the totals THIS document prints — the internal four-way close of its cover is what makes that certain. checkrec.py will therefore show my sums (21,550.00 and 36,573.66) disagreeing with the bracketed stated figures (4,168.61 and 5,341.07); that disagreement is the CACHE's, not the transcription's, and materializing this record against the current cache would mis-gate it. Resolve the attribution before shipping this filing. Two smaller notes: the county blacked out every donor street address on Form A and the candidate's own address on the cover (its own redaction, preserved and not recovered, PRIVACY.md), while the candidate's cell number prints in the clear and is deliberately not carried; and the filer books her one in-kind item on BOTH schedules at 1,000.00, which both printed totals include.
